text: 30-year-old male. The patient reports experiencing left-sided chest pain and a productive cough with purulent sputum for the past week. He mentions shortness of breath. States he was diagnosed with influenza recently but did not adhere to the treatment plan provided.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Community-Acquired Pneumonia (likely Staphylococcus aureus post-influenza).

Based on your recent influenza infection and non-adherence to treatment, combined with productive purulent sputum, I suspect a secondary bacterial pneumonia. I need to confirm the extent of the infection; please REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count and REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray.
